title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 55 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 55)

content.overview: Section 55 provides that a foreign award enforceable under Chapter II is binding for the persons between whom it was made and may be relied upon in Indian proceedings as specified by the Act.
